title: Window traffic lights (close / minimize / zoom)

where: every panel with a title bar
counterexamples: sheets attached to a parent window (they use their own close affordance)
usage.notes: The three buttons live at the top-left of the title bar. The inactive-window state is the state that most Linux ports get wrong: all three lose their colour, two of them hide their glyph.

variants.notes: Bounding box of the three-button cluster, measured from the window frame origin.

border.notes: 1 px darker ring; a soft outer shadow only on the active window.

glyph.notes: Cross appears ONLY in hover/pressed cluster state.
Minus appears only in hover/pressed cluster state.
Two triangles; alternate full-screen glyph when Option is held - separate state.

hover.notes: The hovered button keeps its colour, the others do NOT change; the glyph of the hovered button appears.

inactive-window.notes: All three turn flat grey; glyphs disappear. A themed port that keeps the colours on inactive windows is visibly wrong to anyone who used Mavericks.

keyboard.notes: Cmd+W closes; the lights themselves are never keyboard-focused in Mavericks.

hit_testing.notes: Circular visuals, rectangular hit area in AppKit.

a11y.title: Window controls
a11y.notes: AppKit exposes the cluster as a group of three AXButton children.

provenance.notes: The probe prints the exact frames of the three standard buttons; that output is the missing measurement.

gaps.what: measured frames of closeButton/miniaturizeButton/zoomButton and the exact colour of each state
gaps.issue: docs/UI_REFERENCE/data/uiprobe.json does not exist; PROGRESS.md records the continuation plan (full installer -> Terminal -> DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES)

gaps.what: glyph artwork (cross, minus, triangles) as reproducible MavLinOS assets
gaps.issue: Vector geometry is trivial to redraw clean-room; the record must list the exact size and weight

notes: Everything numeric here is derived from the constraints and is marked low confidence on purpose.
